title: Canonical continuous coefficient pullback and coefficient maps
statement: For schemes $X,Z$ [def-pc-scheme] use their small pro-etale sites and inverse-image/direct-image adjunction [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For a topological commutative ring $T$, put $T_X(U)=C(|U|,T)$ [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-ring-functions-sheaf]. For a scheme morphism $h:Z\to X$ define $\rho_h:T_X\to h_*T_Z$ by precomposition with $U\times_X Z\to U$, and define $c_h:h^{-1}T_X\to T_Z$ to be its adjunct. For a continuous ring homomorphism $\varphi:T\to T\prime$, define the coefficient map $T_X\to T\prime_X$ by postcomposition $s\mapsto\varphi\circ s$. In particular for a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its spectral topology and valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], define $A_X\to E_X$ by postcomposition with the actual inclusion $A\hookrightarrow E$. The integral and rational coefficient types may be lifted into the common coefficient universe without changing their operations or topology.

    [TopologicalSpace T] [CommRing T] [IsTopologicalRing T]
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) :
    continuousCoefficientSheaf X T ⟶
      (proEtaleSheafDirectImage h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (continuousCoefficientSheaf Z T)
